header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (Firefox builds none there, and its line saying so is the one
waited for), Start Game, the logos and the start of the DK Rap; then the main menu, which Start in the Rap reaches,
and Jungle Japes as DK, started by tools/shader_survey.js's surveyMap (from the main menu the game starts on file 3
there), a need that fails the run unless the game is in adventure mode on Japes' map: about 45 s of DK walking in from
the level's entrance and then to and fro, jumping, attacking and turning the camera, clear of the entrance's portal,
which leaves the level, with a shot about 8 s in. Its waits and holds in the level are on the game's own clock,
shader_survey.js's gameTime() (60ths), so every browser walks DK as far whatever frames it gives the game; the last
step reads where the Kong is (gPlayerPointer). tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to three more levels, for when a
